summary: T0-05 meets every acceptance criterion I checked. All four story checks (make check, make test, make web-build, make web-smoke) exit 0. The change reviewed is commit 420ac3f44662a732179728854d8ae18c2b79d907. Changed paths stay within the story's files list. The one exception is an unrelated `/.vscode/` line in `.gitignore`; I rate it low. I did not read config/run.yaml, so I found no invented gate passes or kickoff values. I ran the commands only and did not read the Python bundle validator. Reviewer: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (claude-sonnet-5-5) in Claude Code. Timestamp: 2026-11-14. I did not hash the input artifacts.

checks.evidence: ruff and mypy pass; turbo lint and typecheck: 4 successful
pytest 404 passed; web vitest 80 passed (5 files); schema vitest 157 passed
bundle:pull copied the mock bundle (mock-0); next build 16.4.6 succeeded; route / is ○ static
web-smoke: GET http://127.0.0.1:52944/ (prerendered) shows the mock banner, "Shipping mode: not chosen (G0 NOT_RUN)" and bundle version mock-0 in the footer

checks.criterion: @terraluna/web with Next 16, React 19.2, strict TypeScript, no Tailwind or UI kit
checks.evidence: apps/web/package.json:19-21 pins next 16.4.6 and react 19.2.9; no Tailwind or UI kit dependency. I did not read tsconfig.json to confirm strict mode, but typecheck passes.

checks.criterion: bundle:pull sources, validation and no mock fallback
checks.evidence: apps/web/lib/bundle.ts:61-76,208-222: an unset or empty BUNDLE_VERSION selects the mock, otherwise release/<v>. Both files are validated with the @terraluna/schema Zod schemas. A missing release throws; the test at tests/bundle.test.ts:129 covers this. apps/web/data/ is git-ignored (.gitignore).

checks.criterion: bundle:pull and next build fail on mock=true with VERCEL_ENV=production
checks.evidence: assertDeployable is called in pullBundle (bundle.ts:217) and in loadBundle (bundle.ts:240), which app/layout.tsx:24 runs at build time. Tests: bundle.test.ts:70,74,247; bundle-pull-cli.test.ts:25-28.

checks.criterion: Vitest tests cover production-mock throw, preview/unset pass, missing requested version throw, invalid manifest throw
checks.evidence: bundle.test.ts:70-92 (mock with production throws; preview and unset pass), :129 (missing requested version), :141-168 (invalid manifest cases). The tests check specific errors and file contents, not no-ops.

checks.criterion: / is static and shows the required text and nothing else
checks.evidence: page.tsx sets dynamic='error' and shows only the title. shell.ts:15-29 builds the banner, the shipping-mode line and the footer from manifest.json and validation.json. The build lists / as ○ static. A missing G0 record shows 'not recorded', not a status.
Makefile web-build runs bundle:pull then build. web-smoke depends on web-build and runs scripts/smoke.ts, which the make web-smoke run exercised. web-dev runs bundle:pull then dev.

findings.claim: The `/.vscode/` ignore rule is not needed by this story, but it is harmless.
findings.evidence: The diff for .gitignore adds `/.vscode/`, which has nothing to do with T0-05. It is allowed because .gitignore is in the story's files list.

findings.claim: An unknown VERCEL_ENV value, such as 'prod', makes the build fail instead of being treated as unset.
findings.evidence: The code throws for any VERCEL_ENV other than production, preview, development or unset, and tests/bundle.test.ts:64 covers this. This is stricter than the story requires, but it fails safe.
